description: Comparison-analysis config: cross-attribute statistics for the evaluator. 'grounded_joint_pairs' entries are {pair:[x,y], grounded:bool, basis:str}; grounded=true means the real population's joint over the pair comes from a real API conditional cross-tabulation, grounded=false means the reference joint is itself a marginal product / forced-independence copy. No per-field ISTAT grounding audit exists yet (the SCB audit in docs/scb_population_distribution_analysis.md does not transfer), so no pairs are asserted as grounded here. 'combination_checks' generalise the coherence triple to configurable {attributes, k, threshold} sets. 'c2st' tunes the classifier two-sample test.
